name: Unidentified OOM-series security droid (Luke Skywalker)
description: A OOM-series security droid was a member of a Separatist crew that operated on the planet Loradil during the New Republic Era after their Providence-class carrier was shot down. Around 6 ABY, the OOM-series security droid attempted to locate the human Jedi Luke Skywalker under a Armored Assault Tank, but was unable to before being flung with the Force into another security droid.
